info.title: Ashr++ A3 Commercial Product Console API
info.summary: Machine-readable A3 OpenAPI contract for commercial dashboard, reports, release gate, admin, billing, and trust surfaces.
info.description: This contract translates the existing A3 commercial API matrix into an OpenAPI 3.1 artifact. A3 owns product workflow and UI surfaces; A1 remains the durable platform/API/auth/usage owner; A2 remains the judge/policy/release-gate authority.

x-service-boundary.owner: Product Console / Review Workflow / Report Center / Commercial UI

x-required-commercial-notes.tenant: Every hosted endpoint must be scoped by organization_id, tenant_id, workspace_id, project_id, and environment_id where applicable. Cross-tenant reads must fail closed with sanitized 404 or empty state.
x-required-commercial-notes.auth: Hosted SaaS calls require an authenticated actor or service account supplied by A1. This OpenAPI artifact never stores or displays credential values.
x-required-commercial-notes.rbac: Every customer action must declare a role or permission. Denied states must be explicit and safe for dashboard rendering.
x-required-commercial-notes.usage: Usage meters are read-only in A3 and must come from A1 usage ledger events before billing claims become live.
x-required-commercial-notes.audit: Mutating or shareable actions must emit append-only audit events with ids, refs, hashes, statuses, and counts only.

x-secret-policy.placeholder_policy: Use ids, hashes, aliases, and [REDACTED] only.

x-a1-a2-references.a3_integration_rule: A3 may package and display A1/A2 evidence but must not reinterpret A2 judge semantics or mutate A1 runner/auth/storage behavior.
